notes.title: v1.1.0
notes.content:
-Open endless mode
-The brave must hold on to the 100th floor
-As long as you are strong enough, you can cover the map.

[b]Endless Mode Rules Explained[/b]
-There is only one entrance to the monster.
-Endless mode does not drop crystals
-Cooking will not appear after 100 waves in endless mode
-Each time you enter the store, you can only purchase 1 dish

notes.title: V1.0.2
notes.content:
1. Some bug fixes
2. Add 4x speed


[b]Hi players[/b]

We look at every comment and try to resolve your concerns.

Since 8x speed will cause bullets to be lost, it can only be opened to 4x speed.

We will continue to optimize and improve this game.Hope to give a good review.ːsteamthumbsupː
